verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਹ ਪਜੂਤੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਮਰਦੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੜ ਹੜ ਹਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: seeh pajootee bakaree maradhee hoiee haR haR hasee|

en.bdb: A goat was caught by a lion and while about to die, it gave out a horse­ laugh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਹੁ ਪੁਛੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ ਇਤੁ ਅਉਸਰ ਕਿਤੁ ਰਹਸਿ ਰਹਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: seeh puchhai visamaadh hoi it aausar kit rahas rahasee|

en.bdb: The surprised lion asked why it was so happy at such a moment (of its death).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਖਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: binau kare(n)dhee bakaree putr asaadde keechan khasee|

en.bdb: Humbly the goat replied that the testicals of our male progeny are crushed in order to castrate them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਕੁਹਿ ਕੁਹਿ ਖਲ ਉਖਲਿ ਵਿਣਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: ak dhatooraa khaadhiaa kuh kuh khal ukhal vinasee|

en.bdb: We eat only wild plants of arid regions yet our skin is peeled and pounded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਗਲ ਵਢਿਕੈ ਹਾਲੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੋਵਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: maas khaan gal vaddikai haal tinaaRaa kaun hovasee|

en.bdb: I think about the plight of those (like you) who cut the throat of others and eat their flesh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਦੇਹ ਖੇਹ ਖਾਜੁ ਅਖਾਜੁ ਅਕਾਜੁ ਕਰਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: garab gareebee dheh kheh khaaj akhaaj akaaj karasee|

en.bdb: The body of both of the proud and the humble will become dust ultimately, but, even then the body of the arrogant (lion) is inedible and that of the humble (goat) attaims the status of edible.
All who came to this world have to die ultimately.
